full_page.content:
1928, December
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
Page49 Cont.
Dec. 12 Richard Scherer 1 month old - 2 operations Mrs. Mckinley - lump in shin - flamation. Hazel McKechnie - abcess on lung - bronchitis Coneff
Dec. 14 Mrs. Marg. Mack - Goitre, Nerveous, fears operation. Marg't Don'ly. . St. Joseph's Retr't 3 yrs Fractured Scull- from Port Huron.
J. McMillan 70 of Badax - Erycipalis - son to be priest soon. A. Baumgartner - 66 - dying of Cancer Non Cath. - phones - financial troubles
Marg. E. Tapin - in Mercy Hospital - received all Helen Sm.
Page 50 Dec. 20 Nora Callaha - St. Jo's Retreat - enrolled No. 22 - not to confession in 12 yrs. Reported as "twice now to Sacraments" & improving.
Dec. 26 Long distance Mt. Pleasant - S. Radimacher - double-pneumonia. Case of T.B. - Happy death Epiliptic
